topic: Bir Tawil, a ~2,060 km² area between Egypt and Sudan claimed by neither, exists because the 1899 Anglo-Egyptian Condominium boundary (22°N) and the 1902 administrative boundary disagree; each state asserts the line that gives it the larger Hala'ib Triangle on the Red Sea, so neither can claim Bir Tawil.
policy_note: Every spoken or shown fact → a claim with ≥ 2 independent publishers; core claims need a primary/scholarly source.

myths.myth: Bir Tawil is unclaimed because nobody knows it exists.
myths.reality: Both Egypt and Sudan know it; claiming it would mean accepting the boundary line that hands the far larger Hala'ib Triangle to the other side.

brit_halaib.title: Ḥalāʾib Triangle
brit_halaib.notes: Area of about 20,580 km² on the Red Sea coast; 1899 agreement set the political boundary at 22°N; 1902 administrative boundary gave the area to Sudan; administered by Egypt, claimed by Sudan.

wiki_birtawil.title: Bir Tawil
wiki_birtawil.notes: About 2,060 km²; terra nullius; result of the 1899 (22°N) and 1902 boundaries; claiming it would forfeit the claim to the Hala'ib Triangle.

wiki_halaib.title: Hala'ib Triangle
wiki_halaib.notes: 20,580 km²; towns Hala'ib, Abu Ramad, Shalateen; Egypt administers since the 1990s; Sudan claims; 1902 line placed it under Khartoum.

condominium.publisher: Anglo-Egyptian Condominium Agreement (19 January 1899), text via Wikisource
condominium.title: Agreement between Her Britannic Majesty's Government and the Government of His Highness the Khedive of Egypt relative to the future administration of the Sudan
condominium.notes: Article I: the word Sudan means all territories south of the 22nd parallel of latitude.

registry.title: docs/border_registry.json#halaib_bir_tawil
registry.notes: Halayib Triangle: controller Egypt, claimant Sudan; Bir Tawil: claimed by neither (terra nullius); as of 2026-10.

guardian.title: Welcome to the land that no country wants (2016)
guardian.notes: Bir Tawil, about 2,000 km², unclaimed by Egypt or Sudan because of the two conflicting 1899 and 1902 lines; claiming it means giving up the Hala'ib Triangle.

ibs18.publisher: US Department of State, Office of the Geographer
ibs18.title: International Boundary Study No. 18: Sudan – United Arab Republic (Egypt) Boundary (27 July 1962)
ibs18.notes: Official boundary study: the 1899 Condominium boundary at 22°N, the 1902 administrative boundary and the two areas (Hala'ib north of 22°N administered from Khartoum; Bir Tawil south of it administered from Cairo).

bbc.title: The man who declared himself king of a no man's land (2014)
bbc.notes: Bir Tawil between Egypt and Sudan, unclaimed by either; the 1899 straight line versus the 1902 administrative line; the Hala'ib Triangle is the prize.

claims.text: Bir Tawil (about 2,060 km²) lies between Egypt and Sudan and is claimed by neither state.
vo: between egypt and sudan there is a piece of desert that nobody claims. not forgotten. refused
and the same two lines leave this smaller patch to the other side. claim it, and you accept the line that loses you the coast. so neither does
two thousand square kilometres of desert, unclaimed on purpose, because wanting it would cost the coast
screen: Administered by no state — claimed by neither Egypt nor Sudan (terra nullius)

claims.text: The 1899 Anglo-Egyptian Condominium Agreement set the Egypt–Sudan boundary along the 22nd parallel.
vo: in 1899 britain drew the border along the 22nd parallel. a straight line, east to west

claims.text: In 1902 a separate administrative boundary was drawn following tribal grazing areas, placing the Hala'ib Triangle under Sudan and Bir Tawil under Egypt.
vo: three years later it drew a second line, following the tribes instead: a bend north by the sea, a bend south in the desert

claims.text: The Hala'ib Triangle (about 20,580 km², with Red Sea coast and towns) is administered by Egypt and claimed by Sudan; Egypt relies on the 1899 line and Sudan on the 1902 line.
vo: egypt holds to the straight line. sudan holds to the second. each line gives its owner the big coastal triangle, the one with the red sea and the towns
screen: Red Sea coast · towns · both claim it
